subject: general
question:
Directions: In this section each of the following sentences has a blank space and each sentence is followed by four options. Select the most appropriate option to fill the blank space

All of my efforts to save her life have gone in ______ .
solution: The correct answer is '**vain**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word to fill the given blank is '**vain**'. • In the given sentence **'in vain'** is **a phrasal verb.** • It means 'without success or a result'. (सफलता या परिणाम के बिना) • *Example: They waited in **vain** for a response. * • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **vein**: one of the tubes which carry blood from all parts of your body to your heart. (शरीर के अन्य भागों से हृदय को रक्त पहुँचानेवाली नलिका, रुधिरवाहिनी शिरा, नस) • **van**: a road vehicle that is used for transporting things. [माल ढोने वाली (बंद) मोटर गाड़ी; वैन] • **vane**: a flat blade that is a part of the machinery in a windmill and is moved by wind or water. [पवन चक्‍की का फलक (जो वायु या जल के दबाव में घूमता है), पवनदिशासूचक, वातसूचक] • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *All of my efforts to save her life have gone in **vain**.* 47:T74f, The correct answer is** 'has done'.**
